scope: Bounded read-only source/document review only; no Linux or sandbox execution by reviewer and no proof acceptance claim
source_observations: Landrun811 handles all known V9 filesystem rights, both classic TCP rights and both IPC scopes unless corresponding unrestricted flags are explicitly set. BestEffort is applied only when requested.

go-landlock v0.9.0 restrictTo intersects config masks with actual ABI support. OnABI8 versus9, FS mask is0xffff versus0x1ffff; only bit16 AccessFSResolveUnix is omitted. Net mask0x3, Scoped mask0x3 and supported restriction flags0xf are unchanged.
restrict.go takes TSYNC enforcement path for actualABI>=8. Existing filesystem path rules do not request new --unix access; prior filesystem rights remain available onABI8.
Exact upstream Comparator575 and865 already include --best-effort in their Landrun argument constructor.

coverage.abi8_filesystem: All known filesystem rights through ABI8, including refer/truncate/device-ioctl, retain specified read/write/execute path restrictions. Not the ABI9 ResolveUnix pathname socket connect/sendmsg right.
coverage.tcp: Both classic TCP bind/connect rights remain handled. This is not an assertion that UDP/all networking is denied.
coverage.scopes: Abstract UNIX socket and outside-domain signal scopes remain handled.
coverage.systemd_qualification: RestrictAddressFamilies affects socket(2) creation. Official systemd documentation excludes inherited sockets, socketpair and io_uring; the existing AF_UNIX probe establishes creation denial only, not full ABI9-equivalent UNIX socket mediation.

reviewed_policy: No source-level objection to adding --best-effort to the five harness-owned Landrun calls while requiring Linuxx86_64 plus an explicit detectedABI>=8 floor and actual write-denial/AF_UNIX-creation controls. Keep all path/environment restrictions, source pins and theorem/checker policies unchanged. Disclose narrower ABI8 platform coverage; do not claim fullV9 or a complete UNIX barrier.
